text: {"entries":[{"name_han":"霍小玉传","logic_thesis":"The text proves that a vow is not a speech-act alone but a binding causal contract: once affection is pledged under heaven’s witness, betrayal restructures the moral field so that the wronged party’s qi can return as punitive agency. Li Yi’s career success after abandonment is not reward but deferred debt; the ghost’s vengeance demonstrates that social rank cannot cancel spiritual liability. Fate here is not external doom but the automatic equilibration of broken xin-yi (trust-intention).","logic_chain":"1. Premise: A solemn love-oath creates mutual obligation that heaven registers as real force. 2. Inference: Breaking the oath severs reciprocal qi and generates unresolved resentment (yuan). 3. Inference: Yuan concentrates into posthumous agency capable of acting on the living. 4. Inference: Worldly advancement after betrayal only magnifies the imbalance, attracting retribution. 5. Conclusion: Moral causality outranks institutional success; unpaid emotional debt returns as fate-correction.","logic_practice":"1. In BaZi counseling, treat broken promises and abandoned relationships as open yuan-nodes that can show as sudden illness, lawsuits, or marital collapse in clash years. 2. When chart shows strong Peach Blossom with weak resource/official, warn that charm without yi (constancy) invites reverse-karmic strikes. 3. Cultivation practice: never swear lightly; if a vow is broken, ritual confession and reparative action before the damage compounds. 4. Read ‘ghost revenge’ as metaphor for subconscious guilt and social network feedback, not only literal spirit attack.","logic_compare":"Unlike 莺莺传, which rationalizes male abandonment as moral hygiene, 霍小玉传 refuses the scholar’s self-absolution and centers the woman’s causal power after death. Unlike 李娃传, redemption is unavailable once the oath is voided—the logic is retributive rather than educative. Its Daoist weight lies in proving that emotion is qi-matter with accounting rules, not private sentiment."},{"name_han":"李娃传","logic_thesis":"The text proves that character is not fixed by birth-station: a courtesan’s sustained ren (humaneness) can reverse a scholar’s complete social death and rebuild him into official success. Degeneration and regeneration form a reversible cycle driven by environment and moral choice, not by immutable ming. True virtue is measured by costly fidelity under shame, not by pedigree.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Social collapse (beggary, illness) follows excess and abandonment of discipline. 2. Inference: External degradation does not erase latent capacity if moral support returns. 3. Inference: The lowest-status agent can be the highest-virtue agent when she risks self for another’s recovery. 4. Inference: Restored body, learning, and reputation follow ordered re-cultivation (care → study → exam). 5. Conclusion: Fate is path-dependent and co-authored; ren can rewrite a ruined trajectory.","logic_practice":"1. In charts with Wealth/Officer destroyed then revived by Resource stars in luck cycles, narrate as 李娃-type recovery rather than permanent doom. 2. Teach clients that ‘low’ relationships may carry high moral capital—do not rank help by status. 3. Cultivation: after collapse, sequence matters—heal body/qi first, then skill, then public role. 4. When Day Master is weak and Friends/Rob Wealth harm, seek a strong Resource person as stabilizer (the Li Wa function).","logic_compare":"Contrasts with 霍小玉传 by proving restorative rather than retributive causality: the wronged or ‘base’ woman becomes salvific. Differs from 莺莺传 by denying that a fallen woman permanently pollutes a man’s destiny. Its logic is Confucian-Daoist hybrid: environment shapes qi, but deliberate ren can reverse entropy."},{"name_han":"长恨歌传","logic_thesis":"The text proves that imperial passion, when unmeasured, becomes a structural cause of dynastic disorder: private desire and public mandate are not separate realms but linked vessels. Xuanzong–Yang love is both genuine and catastrophic, so the argument is not ‘love is false’ but ‘love without boundary destroys the vessel that holds it.’ After political death, yearning persists as immortal longing—proving that emotional qi outlives institutional form, yet cannot undo historical consequence.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Ruler’s qi is amplified by position; personal excess scales into state excess. 2. Inference: Favor concentrated on one beauty displaces ministers, military vigilance, and ritual measure. 3. Inference: Rebellion and death are not random tragedy but systemic feedback from imbalance. 4. Inference: Remorse and immortal reunion fantasies heal the heart, not the polity already broken. 5. Conclusion: Unregulated qing (feeling) at the center of power converts romance into historical fate.","logic_practice":"1. For charts with extreme Peach Blossom + Power (官杀) without Seal/Resource moderation, flag ‘Xuanzong pattern’: success inverted by obsession. 2. Advise leaders: private attachments need institutional firewalls; chart ‘favoritism’ shows as over-strong Wife/Wealth star consuming Officer. 3. Cultivation: practice measure (节) in desire; intensity without form is fire without stove. 4. After irreversible loss, use ritual remembrance without letting nostalgia dictate new decisions.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure love tragedies (霍小玉), the causal unit is the empire, not only the couple. Unlike 白娘子, the ‘demon’ is not the beloved woman as alien species but the sovereign’s own excess. It differs from 论衡-style skepticism by accepting spirit-realm aftermath while still holding political causality primary."},{"name_han":"无双传","logic_thesis":"The text proves that loyalty (zhong-yi) plus strategic cunning can pierce seemingly absolute institutional barriers: fate is hard, but not a closed system when agents refuse despair and exploit loopholes of bureaucracy, medicine, and underworld skill. Wushuang’s preservation and reunion demonstrate that ‘dead’ statuses (official death, palace enclosure) are paper realities that higher resolve can rewrite. The argument elevates resourceful fidelity over passive acceptance of ming.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Political chaos severs lovers and creates false endings (sale, death reports). 2. Inference: Literal obedience to official narrative yields permanent loss. 3. Inference: Allies with specialized skills (servant-knights, drugs, disguise) can reverse administrative finality. 4. Inference: Risk accepted for yi generates improbable but coherent success. 5. Conclusion: Destiny includes contingency windows; courage and craft open them.","logic_practice":"1. When BaZi shows severe Official pressure but strong Output/Friend helpers, counsel ‘Wushuang strategy’: find unconventional human tools, not head-on collision. 2. In clash years that look like total endings, check for hidden combination/rescue stars before declaring doom. 3. Cultivation: train both yi (loyal intention) and shu (method); virtue without skill is martyrdom. 4. Ritual: treat ‘dead ends’ as transformable labels—rename the problem, then re-enter.","logic_compare":"Unlike 霍小玉传, agency stays with the living and succeeds without ghost revenge. Unlike 莺莺传, male loyalty holds under cost. Compared with 李娃传, the obstacle is state machinery more than moral degradation—logic of political craft rather than moral re-education."},{"name_han":"莺莺传","logic_thesis":"The text proves—and self-indicts—the scholar ideology that renames desire as ‘demonic temptation’ after satiation, converting a mutual bond into a morality play that excuses abandonment. Yuan Zhen’s narrator argues that beautiful women are jiu (calamity) to be expelled for self-preservation; the deeper logic exposed is that elite male career calculus can metabolize guilt into doctrine. The work is a laboratory of bad faith: it shows how moral language is retrofitted to serve ambition.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Passionate union occurs under poetry, secrecy, and mutual initiative. 2. Inference: When career trajectory demands ‘purity’ and advantageous marriage, the bond becomes a liability. 3. Inference: The man reclassifies the woman as dangerous femme fatale rather than partner. 4. Inference: Public moralizing legitimizes private betrayal and silences her claim. 5. Conclusion: Ideology can invert cause: the abandoner frames himself as victim of beauty’s hazard.","logic_practice":"1. In counseling, detect ‘Yingying rhetoric’ when clients blame partners’ allure for their own boundary failures. 2. BaZi: strong Eating God/Hurting Officer storytelling with weak Officer integrity can indicate clever self-justification patterns. 3. Cultivation: audit post-hoc moral narratives—ask what benefit the story protects. 4. For relationship charts, require both parties’ agency; refuse readings that make one side pure yin-demon.","logic_compare":"Antithesis of 霍小玉传 and 李娃传: here the woman lacks posthumous or redemptive power; male discourse wins. Differs from 长恨歌传 by shrinking catastrophe from empire to private casuistry. Its value for Daoist logic is negative teaching—how false ming-talk masks choice."},{"name_han":"鬼董","logic_thesis":"As a ghost-tale repository, 鬼董 proves that the dead remain morally continuous with the living: unfinished grievance, improper burial, and unjust killing generate persistent agents that demand correction. The collection’s logic is forensic more than spectacular—ghosts function as evidence that the cosmos keeps accounts when human courts fail. Spectral phenomena are treated as readable signs in a shared causal order, not random horror.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Violent or unjust death leaves unspent qi and unpaid claims. 2. Inference: That residue can appear as haunting, dream-indictment, or omen. 3. Inference: Proper investigation, burial, or restitution settles the manifestation. 4. Inference: Ignoring the sign multiplies disorder in the living household/locale. 5. Conclusion: Spirit events are ethical diagnostics of incomplete justice.","logic_practice":"1. When charts show strong 印/官 with sudden yin-clash and ancestral illness themes, consider ‘unfinished family cases’ as part of counseling scope (without superstition theater). 2. Use ghost-logic as metaphor for trauma inheritance and legal loose ends. 3. Cultivation: complete rites for the dead; leave no deliberate injustice unpaid. 4. In fengshui/year-luck, treat recurring nightmare-omens as prompts to correct concrete wrongs first.","logic_compare":"More systematic and case-like than single romantic ghosting in 霍小玉传. Less philosophically skeptical than 论衡, which denies many spirit claims; 鬼董 assumes a populated moral cosmos. Differs from 西湖三塔记 by emphasizing justice-seeking dead over seductive demoness predation."},{"name_han":"摭青杂说","logic_thesis":"The miscellany form proves that moral and social truths are best captured as distributed anecdotes rather than single dogma: pattern emerges from many small causal episodes of reward, fraud, coincidence, and bureaucratic life. It argues implicitly that reality’s logic is granular—virtue and cunning leave traces in everyday bargains, marriages, and official posts. Knowledge is inductive: collect cases, then infer regularities of ren and li.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Human affairs are too varied for one narrative template. 2. Inference: Brief factual/moral sketches preserve causal kernels without epic distortion. 3. Inference: Recurring outcomes across tales reveal stable ethical mechanics (cheat → exposure; kindness → return). 4. Inference: The reader becomes a pattern-learner rather than a devotee of one hero. 5. Conclusion: Wisdom is statistical-moral: many small proofs converge on how ming and xing interact.","logic_practice":"1. Train BaZi students with case libraries (like 杂说): many charts beat one theory. 2. When a single classical rule fails, add counter-cases before discarding the rule. 3. Cultivation: keep a personal ‘杂说’ journal of cause-effect in daily conduct. 4. Prefer modest, testable claims over grand fate proclamations.","logic_compare":"Unlike 春秋繁露 or 白虎通义, it does not build a closed cosmological system; its authority is empirical-anecdotal. Unlike chuanqi masterpieces focused on one passion, it democratizes logic across ordinary lives. Closest in spirit to 论衡’s case-mindedness but without Wang Chong’s systematic polemic."},{"name_han":"论衡","logic_thesis":"Wang Chong proves that many ‘heavenly’ and omen claims fail when tested against consistency, proportion, and natural mechanism: thunder, disasters, sages’ births, and ghostly anecdotes must obey the same qi physics as ordinary events. The core argument is epistemic hygiene—correlate claims with verifiable patterns; reject flattering teleology that makes heaven a moral micromanager of every human reward. Destiny exists as endowment and circumstance, but not as constant moral puppetry.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: True principles must apply uniformly, not only to sages and kings. 2. Inference: If heaven instantly punishes evil, the thriving of villains contradicts the theory. 3. Inference: Many portents are natural qi transformations misread as messages. 4. Inference: Exaggerated miracle-tales inflate human prestige, not cosmic fact. 5. Conclusion: Critical naturalism is a moral duty; superstition is bad reasoning, not piety.","logic_practice":"1. In BaZi practice, separate structural chart logic from fear-based folk taboos; demand repeatable rules. 2. When clients bring omens, ask for base rates and alternative natural causes first. 3. Cultivation: empty the mind of flattering ‘heaven favors me’ stories; keep yi aligned with evidence. 4. Use 论衡 as quality-control: every fate claim needs mechanism + counterexample check. 5. Teach that skepticism protects Dao rather than insulting it.","logic_compare":"Directly opposes 春秋繁露’s dense heaven-human reward machinery and 白虎通义’s sacralized institutions. Differs from ghost fiction (鬼董, 白娘子) by demoting spirits as default explainers. Its kinship is with scientific Dao: order without arbitrary miracle."},{"name_han":"白虎通义","logic_thesis":"The text proves that political order is legitimate only when it mirrors a standardized cosmic taxonomy: ranks, kinship, rituals, and punishments are justified as enactments of yin-yang and five-phase structure, not mere custom. By freezing debate into orthodox definitions, it argues that social language must be calibrated to heaven’s categories or the state loses sacral coherence. Logic here is classificatory: correct names → correct roles → stable realm.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Heaven’s patterns (yin-yang, wuxing, directions) are normative, not decorative. 2. Inference: Human offices and family grades should encode those patterns. 3. Inference: Ritual and law are technologies for keeping names aligned with cosmic roles. 4. Inference: Heterodox naming breeds political chaos. 5. Conclusion: Orthodoxy is a logical instrument of cosmic-political resonance.","logic_practice":"1. Map BaZi ten-gods ethics to role clarity: Officer as duty-name, Resource as legitimation, Wealth as proper exchange—misnamed roles create chart ‘chaos.’ 2. In counseling institutions, restore clear titles/responsibilities before luck-cycle talk. 3. Cultivation: practice zhengming in speech—say what relations truly are. 4. Use wuxing seasonality as calendar for work/rest, not only divination ornament.","logic_compare":"More institutional and handbook-like than 春秋繁露’s prophetic, resonant cosmology. Less critical than 论衡; it constructs sacred bureaucracy rather than testing it. Differs from 新语 by heavier scholastic systematization after imperial Confucianism has already won."},{"name_han":"春秋繁露","logic_thesis":"Dong Zhongshu proves a correlative causal thesis: heaven and humanity form one resonant body, so royal virtue and vice stimulate corresponding climatic, astronomical, and social effects. History (Spring and Autumn) is read as coded case law of that resonance, elevating the ruler’s self-cultivation into the master variable of collective fate. The argument welds ethics, cosmology, and politics into a single feedback system.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Qi connects celestial signs, seasons, and human conduct. 2. Inference: The ruler’s xin is the most amplified node in that network. 3. Inference: Portents are warnings within a moral-cybernetic loop, not pure accidents. 4. Inference: Reform of policy and person can retune heaven’s response. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation of the sovereign (and by extension the self) is cosmological engineering.","logic_practice":"1. Read annual luck as resonance feedback: clashes/punishments as ‘warnings’ to adjust conduct, not only as hits to endure. 2. For leadership charts, prioritize Day Master balance + Officer harmony as state-of-body politics. 3. Cultivation: daily examine intention; small xin-deviations scale up in high-responsibility positions. 4. Use five-phase correspondences therapeutically (seasonal living) while avoiding fatalistic omen panic—pair with 论衡’s checks.","logic_compare":"Maximal heaven-human micromanagement versus 论衡’s critique. More dynamic and omen-centered than 白虎通义’s static definitions. Unlike novelistic karma (霍小玉), resonance is institutional and climatic, not primarily romantic-ghostly."},{"name_han":"新语","logic_thesis":"Lu Jia proves that newly won empire cannot be held by force alone: the same martial logic that conquers becomes the seed of collapse unless replaced by ren-yi governance and measured institutions. The argument is transitional causality—tools must change when phases change; success-pattern of wartime is peacetime poison. Virtue is not soft ornament but the hard technology of duration.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Qin’s fall shows that severe law and conquest-qi exhaust the people. 2. Inference: Han must switch from taking the world to keeping the world. 3. Inference: Moral persuasion, frugality, and ritual order lower systemic friction. 4. Inference: Legitimacy compounds when rulers model restraint. 5. Conclusion: Phase-appropriate method is the logic of lasting ming for a regime.","logic_practice":"1. In BaZi decade luck, when output/war stars give way to resource/official phases, retrain strategy: stop ‘conquest habits’ in career/relationships. 2. After any victory (exam, wealth windfall), install ren-yi routines immediately. 3. Cultivation: ask ‘what phase am I in?’ before applying old tactics. 4. Counsel founders: building and sustaining need different five-element emphases.","logic_compare":"Earlier and leaner than 春秋繁露’s full correlative theology; more practical-political than 白虎通义’s encyclopedic orthodoxy. Differs from literary cautionary tales by addressing statecraft directly rather than through romance allegory."},{"name_han":"茶经","logic_thesis":"Lu Yu proves that a humble material practice—tea—can encode the entire path of discrimination, timing, and harmony: tool, water, fire, leaf, and drinker must co-resonate or the Dao of tea fails. The argument elevates craft to cultivation: excellence is the alignment of process variables, not mystical gift. Aesthetic discipline trains the same faculties needed for governing self and sensing qi.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Tea quality emerges only when multiple conditions are correctly staged. 2. Inference: Each error (bad water, wrong fire, coarse implement) is diagnosable and correctable. 3. Inference: The practitioner’s attention is itself an ingredient. 4. Inference: Repeated refined practice stabilizes taste, body, and mind together. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation is exacting process design applied to daily matter.","logic_practice":"1. Treat BaZi reading as tea craft: sequence (year-month-day-hour), proportion, and context—no single star sipped alone. 2. Daily tea (or analogous ritual) as mindfulness of fire-water balance in the body chart. 3. Cultivation: refine one ordinary act to mastery; transfer that discrimination to emotion and speech. 4. In weak Earth/Resource charts, use slow, warm, ritualized routines to tonify. 5. Teach clients: fate work is quality control, not spells.","logic_compare":"Unlike cosmological summae (春秋繁露), it proves metaphysics through craft empiricism. Unlike moral biographies, it barely moralizes yet yields ethical calm via form. Closest to Daoist techne: the way is in the doing’s precision."},{"name_han":"碾玉观音","logic_thesis":"The story proves that crafted beauty and human passion create durable soul-bonds that outlast murder and institutional violence: the jade Guanyin is both commodity and spiritual double of the beloved. Art objectifies affection into a portable fate-token; attempts to possess persons as property generate lethal pushback from the life-force so compressed. Love’s logic here is artisanal and spectral—form retains intent.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Mastery embeds the maker’s and lover’s qi into the work. 2. Inference: The artwork becomes a hinge between social world and spirit world. 3. Inference: Forcing lovers apart for elite convenience ruptures that hinge violently. 4. Inference: Posthumous reunion via the jade image restores moral symmetry. 5. Conclusion: Objectified beauty can carry unfinished destiny across death.","logic_practice":"1. When charts show strong Output (食伤) + Wealth, warn that creations and lovers intertwine—destroying one harms the other. 2. Counsel artisans: works hold intention; create cleanly. 3. Cultivation: treat treasured objects as mirrors of attachment; release possession-greed. 4. In grief work, a crafted memorial can stabilize qi better than abstract denial.","logic_compare":"More object-mediated than 霍小玉’s pure ghost vengeance. Less bureaucratic than 无双传’s living stratagems. Differs from 白娘子 by centering human craft-sanctity rather than species-crossing demon-love, though both seal passion into monuments."},{"name_han":"错斩崔宁","logic_thesis":"The text proves that judicial certainty built on coincidence is a machine for manufacturing innocent ghosts: when officials prefer narrative neatness over causal proof, the legal system becomes a karma factory. Random adjacency (timing, words, objects) is misread as guilt, demonstrating a logic of epistemic sin—laziness of investigation as moral crime. Tragedy is not fate’s cruelty alone but method’s failure.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: True judgment requires distinguishing correlation from causation. 2. Inference: Circumstantial clusters can mimic guilt under stress and greed for closure. 3. Inference: Torture and haste convert hypothesis into ‘confession.’ 4. Inference: Wrongful death generates social and spectral debt. 5. Conclusion: Righteous process is a cosmic duty; bad epistemology kills.","logic_practice":"1. In BaZi/event analysis, forbid single-sign verdicts—require multi-factor triangulation (like good detective work). 2. When Officer stars are harsh without Resource clarity, flag wrongful accusation years; advise documentation and calm procedure. 3. Cultivation: slow down judgment of others; practice ‘doubt as compassion.’ 4. Organizational counsel: incentive structures that reward quick closure invite 错斩 patterns.","logic_compare":"Unlike romance-driven Tang tales, the villain is procedure itself. Aligns with 论衡’s demand for testing, but dramatized as courtroom horror. Differs from 鬼董 by showing how living courts, not only past murders, birth new wrongs."},{"name_han":"西湖三塔记","logic_thesis":"The tale proves that unchecked erotic-yin allure without anchoring yi becomes predatory depletion: beautiful beings at West Lake seduce, imprison, and consume men, encoding a warning about desire-fields that look like pleasure and act like traps. The three towers as seal demonstrate that chaotic seduction must be fixed by ritual structure—form binds excessive yin. Survival depends on recognizing pattern early and invoking ordered power.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Scenic beauty and sexual hospitality can mask extractive intent. 2. Inference: Repeated vanishing of men indicates a stable predatory mechanism, not accident. 3. Inference: Ordinary charm cannot reform entities whose nature is to drain. 4. Inference: Sacred sealing (towers/ritual) restores landscape balance. 5. Conclusion: Some attractions are not relationships but ecosystems of consumption; only boundary-form ends them.","logic_practice":"1. Peach Blossom + heavy yin water without Officer/Resource: counsel strict boundaries in nightlife, speculative romance, ‘magical’ partners. 2. Teach recognition of energy drain after encounters—body is evidence. 3. Cultivation: tower-logic = vows, schedules, community seals against addiction loops. 4. Fengshui metaphor: seal ‘leaking’ sectors of life where qi exits via lust or fantasy.","logic_compare":"Harsher than 白娘子, which allows genuine love before sealing; here the feminine spectral is primarily lethal. Unlike 莺莺传’s male blame-shift, the danger is dramatized as external demon to train vigilance—though modern reading must not misogynize the symbol. Differs from 灌园叟 by showing hostile rather than benevolent nature-spirits."},{"name_han":"灌园叟晚逢仙女","logic_thesis":"The story proves that disinterested care for living beauty (flowers) aligns a humble human with immortal justice: devotion without possession-greed summons protective numen, while destructive bullies draw retribution. Late-life reward demonstrates that sincerity accumulates interest; age does not bar communion with the Dao of nature. The garden is a moral cosmos in miniature.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Plants are living partners in qi, not mere decoration. 2. Inference: Daily non-violent tending builds reciprocity with nature’s spirits. 3. Inference: Wanton destruction of beauty is violence against that order. 4. Inference: Immortal response vindicates the gardener and punishes the wreckers. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation of care is efficacious prayer; heaven backs measured biophilia.","logic_practice":"1. For lonely late-luck charts, prescribe tangible care practice (plants, craft) as Resource-star generation. 2. When Wealth is strong but kindness weak, warn of ‘flower-trampling’ karma in business. 3. Cultivation: serve without owning; admire without plucking—the Daoist non-grasping aesthetic. 4. Seasonal gardening as wuxing embodiment training.","logic_compare":"Inverse of 西湖三塔记’s hostile nature-femme: here the fairy is just and salvific. Softer commercial fate than 转运汉; the capital is virtue-care, not trade cunning. Differs from imperial resonance texts by locating heaven’s feedback in a backyard garden, not the throne."},{"name_han":"转运汉遇巧洞庭红","logic_thesis":"The tale proves that fortune’s turn often rides on undervalued goods, timing, and cross-market arbitrage: what is trivial at home can be precious abroad, so ‘destiny’ appears when perception and logistics meet opportunity. The logic is proto-economic Dao—value is relational, not intrinsic; luck is preparedness colliding with asymmetric demand. Moral of circulation: stagnation is poverty of imagination, not only of capital.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Local surplus can be foreign scarcity. 2. Inference: Agents who move goods across contexts capture hidden value. 3. Inference: Prior ‘failure’ at home may be misallocation of talents/goods, not absolute uselessness. 4. Inference: One well-timed cargo rewrites social status. 5. Conclusion: Ming includes commercial topology; reading markets is reading qi-flows of desire.","logic_practice":"1. Charts with Traveling Horse + Wealth: emphasize mobility, export of skills, not local grinding. 2. Counsel ‘Dongting orange’ audits: what do I undervalue that another field needs? 3. Cultivation: stay light enough to move when luck pivots; hoarding fixed identity blocks 转运. 4. In annual luck, act in the first window of a wealth combination—hesitation misses cargo tides.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure moral reward tales (灌园叟), pivot is mercantile cleverness plus chance. Unlike 错斩崔宁, coincidence is beneficent when paired with enterprise. Differs from 镜花缘’s satirical voyages by celebrating profit logistics over utopian anthropology."},{"name_han":"白娘子永镇雷峰塔","logic_thesis":"The legend proves a tragic collision between species-law (or cosmic ordinance) and sincere cross-boundary love: White Snake’s devotion is real, yet her nature violates the order Fahai polices, so compassion and doctrine cannot fully reconcile. Sealing under Leifeng Pagoda argues that society/religion will immobilize desires that threaten categorical boundaries, even at the cost of human happiness. The child and lingering sympathy show partial integration—love leaves lineage even when the lover is suppressed.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Beings of different ontological orders can form genuine qing. 2. Inference: That qing still triggers guardians of categorical law. 3. Inference: Human spouse is torn between lived gratitude and doctrinal fear. 4. Inference: Institutional sacred power can contain but not annihilate the story’s moral claim. 5. Conclusion: Order and love are co-truths; tragedy is their non-identity in a given age.","logic_practice":"1. Relationship counseling: identify ‘species clashes’—class, family cult, lifestyle cosmologies—that act as Fahai. 2. BaZi: strong yin-Water Peach Blossom vs strong Standing Officer/seven-kill religious authority patterns. 3. Cultivation: know which boundaries protect growth and which only police difference. 4. Ritual ‘tower’ as voluntary containment of addictive love until integration matures—not only external oppression. 5. Honor offspring/projects born of difficult unions as legitimate qi continuation.","logic_compare":"More ethically ambivalent than 西湖三塔记’s clear demon-threat. Unlike 霍小玉, the nonhuman woman is lover-benefactor, not only avenger. Differs from 长恨歌传 by making the boundary cosmic-species rather than solely political excess—though both end in sealed longing."},{"name_han":"镜花缘","logic_thesis":"Li Ruzhen proves by inverted countries and exams for women that ‘nature’ of gender and custom is often local convention mirrored as necessity: travel defamiliarizes the homeland’s logic and exposes its contingency. Talent (cai) exists widely; institutions that refuse to measure it waste cosmic endowment. The mirror-flower image argues that ideal orders are visible yet hard to grasp—critique without naive utopia of easy arrival.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Social rules feel natural only from inside. 2. Inference: Encountering inverted norms reveals the constructedness of one’s own. 3. Inference: Women’s exclusion from literary-official glory is custom-failure, not heaven’s decree. 4. Inference: Satire educates freer measurement of human worth. 5. Conclusion: True cosmic logic values cultivated talent over inherited role-fictions.","logic_practice":"1. In BaZi, read Output/Resource in any sex’s chart as real capacity—refuse cultural discounting. 2. Use ‘foreign kingdom’ thought-experiments with clients stuck in family scripts. 3. Cultivation: travel, languages, and alien crafts as mirrors that polish self-knowledge. 4. Exam/talent systems: design fair measures; biased gates create false ming.","logic_compare":"Broader sociological mirror than single-hero chuanqi. Less despairing than 老残游记’s diagnostic realism; still playful-utopian. Differs from 白虎通义 by prying open orthodox role taxonomy rather than sacralizing it."},{"name_han":"老残游记","logic_thesis":"The novel proves that a civilization in late decay needs diagnostic perception more than heroic posturing: Lao Can’s itinerant doctor-gaze models how to read symptoms in rivers, courts, and ‘honest’ officials whose rigidity kills. Good intentions without systemic understanding become new instruments of harm; clear seeing is the prerequisite of any cure. Fate of the age is a medical case: misdiagnosis multiplies death.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Social illness presents as flood, injustice, and performative virtue. 2. Inference: Surface moralism can mask procedural cruelty. 3. Inference: The observer who lacks office may see clearer than those trapped in role. 4. Inference: Partial technical fixes (engineering, legal shrewdness) help only if diagnosis is true. 5. Conclusion: Cultivated attention—clinical, mobile, unfooled—is the core political-spiritual skill in an ending phase.","logic_practice":"1. BaZi for eras/orgs: when Officer is fake-strong and Resource corrupted, prioritize truth-telling over loyalty theater. 2. Personal cultivation: develop ‘Lao Can eyes’—tour symptoms, test interventions, avoid savior complex. 3. In clash periods of national or company life, be itinerant learner, not rigid partisan. 4. Medicine metaphor for luck cycles: tonify what is deficient, drain what is excess—never punish the symptom alone. 5. Document cases like a travelogue; pattern recognition beats slogan.","logic_compare":"Darker and more realist than 镜花缘’s allegory-tour. Unlike Han cosmological manuals that assume reform from the throne’s virtue alone, it trusts peripheral diagnostic intelligence. Differs from justice tales like 错斩崔宁 by embedding single wrongs in a whole failing organism—the late-Qing body politic."}]}
thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from 20 classical Chinese texts as a BaZi/Daoist scholar. They want ONLY JSON output with a specific schema.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that a vow is not a speech-act alone but a binding causal contract: once affection is pledged under heaven’s witness, betrayal restructures the moral field so that the wronged party’s qi can return as punitive agency. Li Yi’s career success after abandonment is not reward but deferred debt; the ghost’s vengeance demonstrates that social rank cannot cancel spiritual liability. Fate here is not external doom but the automatic equilibration of broken xin-yi (trust-intention).
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: A solemn love-oath creates mutual obligation that heaven registers as real force. 2. Inference: Breaking the oath severs reciprocal qi and generates unresolved resentment (yuan). 3. Inference: Yuan concentrates into posthumous agency capable of acting on the living. 4. Inference: Worldly advancement after betrayal only magnifies the imbalance, attracting retribution. 5. Conclusion: Moral causality outranks institutional success; unpaid emotional debt returns as fate-correction.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi counseling, treat broken promises and abandoned relationships as open yuan-nodes that can show as sudden illness, lawsuits, or marital collapse in clash years. 2. When chart shows strong Peach Blossom with weak resource/official, warn that charm without yi (constancy) invites reverse-karmic strikes. 3. Cultivation practice: never swear lightly; if a vow is broken, ritual confession and reparative action before the damage compounds. 4. Read ‘ghost revenge’ as metaphor for subconscious guilt and social network feedback, not only literal spirit attack.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 莺莺传, which rationalizes male abandonment as moral hygiene, 霍小玉传 refuses the scholar’s self-absolution and centers the woman’s causal power after death. Unlike 李娃传, redemption is unavailable once the oath is voided—the logic is retributive rather than educative. Its Daoist weight lies in proving that emotion is qi-matter with accounting rules, not private sentiment.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that character is not fixed by birth-station: a courtesan’s sustained ren (humaneness) can reverse a scholar’s complete social death and rebuild him into official success. Degeneration and regeneration form a reversible cycle driven by environment and moral choice, not by immutable ming. True virtue is measured by costly fidelity under shame, not by pedigree.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Social collapse (beggary, illness) follows excess and abandonment of discipline. 2. Inference: External degradation does not erase latent capacity if moral support returns. 3. Inference: The lowest-status agent can be the highest-virtue agent when she risks self for another’s recovery. 4. Inference: Restored body, learning, and reputation follow ordered re-cultivation (care → study → exam). 5. Conclusion: Fate is path-dependent and co-authored; ren can rewrite a ruined trajectory.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In charts with Wealth/Officer destroyed then revived by Resource stars in luck cycles, narrate as 李娃-type recovery rather than permanent doom. 2. Teach clients that ‘low’ relationships may carry high moral capital—do not rank help by status. 3. Cultivation: after collapse, sequence matters—heal body/qi first, then skill, then public role. 4. When Day Master is weak and Friends/Rob Wealth harm, seek a strong Resource person as stabilizer (the Li Wa function).
entries.logic_compare: Contrasts with 霍小玉传 by proving restorative rather than retributive causality: the wronged or ‘base’ woman becomes salvific. Differs from 莺莺传 by denying that a fallen woman permanently pollutes a man’s destiny. Its logic is Confucian-Daoist hybrid: environment shapes qi, but deliberate ren can reverse entropy.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that imperial passion, when unmeasured, becomes a structural cause of dynastic disorder: private desire and public mandate are not separate realms but linked vessels. Xuanzong–Yang love is both genuine and catastrophic, so the argument is not ‘love is false’ but ‘love without boundary destroys the vessel that holds it.’ After political death, yearning persists as immortal longing—proving that emotional qi outlives institutional form, yet cannot undo historical consequence.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Ruler’s qi is amplified by position; personal excess scales into state excess. 2. Inference: Favor concentrated on one beauty displaces ministers, military vigilance, and ritual measure. 3. Inference: Rebellion and death are not random tragedy but systemic feedback from imbalance. 4. Inference: Remorse and immortal reunion fantasies heal the heart, not the polity already broken. 5. Conclusion: Unregulated qing (feeling) at the center of power converts romance into historical fate.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For charts with extreme Peach Blossom + Power (官杀) without Seal/Resource moderation, flag ‘Xuanzong pattern’: success inverted by obsession. 2. Advise leaders: private attachments need institutional firewalls; chart ‘favoritism’ shows as over-strong Wife/Wealth star consuming Officer. 3. Cultivation: practice measure (节) in desire; intensity without form is fire without stove. 4. After irreversible loss, use ritual remembrance without letting nostalgia dictate new decisions.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure love tragedies (霍小玉), the causal unit is the empire, not only the couple. Unlike 白娘子, the ‘demon’ is not the beloved woman as alien species but the sovereign’s own excess. It differs from 论衡-style skepticism by accepting spirit-realm aftermath while still holding political causality primary.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that loyalty (zhong-yi) plus strategic cunning can pierce seemingly absolute institutional barriers: fate is hard, but not a closed system when agents refuse despair and exploit loopholes of bureaucracy, medicine, and underworld skill. Wushuang’s preservation and reunion demonstrate that ‘dead’ statuses (official death, palace enclosure) are paper realities that higher resolve can rewrite. The argument elevates resourceful fidelity over passive acceptance of ming.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Political chaos severs lovers and creates false endings (sale, death reports). 2. Inference: Literal obedience to official narrative yields permanent loss. 3. Inference: Allies with specialized skills (servant-knights, drugs, disguise) can reverse administrative finality. 4. Inference: Risk accepted for yi generates improbable but coherent success. 5. Conclusion: Destiny includes contingency windows; courage and craft open them.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When BaZi shows severe Official pressure but strong Output/Friend helpers, counsel ‘Wushuang strategy’: find unconventional human tools, not head-on collision. 2. In clash years that look like total endings, check for hidden combination/rescue stars before declaring doom. 3. Cultivation: train both yi (loyal intention) and shu (method); virtue without skill is martyrdom. 4. Ritual: treat ‘dead ends’ as transformable labels—rename the problem, then re-enter.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 霍小玉传, agency stays with the living and succeeds without ghost revenge. Unlike 莺莺传, male loyalty holds under cost. Compared with 李娃传, the obstacle is state machinery more than moral degradation—logic of political craft rather than moral re-education.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves—and self-indicts—the scholar ideology that renames desire as ‘demonic temptation’ after satiation, converting a mutual bond into a morality play that excuses abandonment. Yuan Zhen’s narrator argues that beautiful women are jiu (calamity) to be expelled for self-preservation; the deeper logic exposed is that elite male career calculus can metabolize guilt into doctrine. The work is a laboratory of bad faith: it shows how moral language is retrofitted to serve ambition.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Passionate union occurs under poetry, secrecy, and mutual initiative. 2. Inference: When career trajectory demands ‘purity’ and advantageous marriage, the bond becomes a liability. 3. Inference: The man reclassifies the woman as dangerous femme fatale rather than partner. 4. Inference: Public moralizing legitimizes private betrayal and silences her claim. 5. Conclusion: Ideology can invert cause: the abandoner frames himself as victim of beauty’s hazard.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In counseling, detect ‘Yingying rhetoric’ when clients blame partners’ allure for their own boundary failures. 2. BaZi: strong Eating God/Hurting Officer storytelling with weak Officer integrity can indicate clever self-justification patterns. 3. Cultivation: audit post-hoc moral narratives—ask what benefit the story protects. 4. For relationship charts, require both parties’ agency; refuse readings that make one side pure yin-demon.
entries.logic_compare: Antithesis of 霍小玉传 and 李娃传: here the woman lacks posthumous or redemptive power; male discourse wins. Differs from 长恨歌传 by shrinking catastrophe from empire to private casuistry. Its value for Daoist logic is negative teaching—how false ming-talk masks choice.

entries.logic_thesis: As a ghost-tale repository, 鬼董 proves that the dead remain morally continuous with the living: unfinished grievance, improper burial, and unjust killing generate persistent agents that demand correction. The collection’s logic is forensic more than spectacular—ghosts function as evidence that the cosmos keeps accounts when human courts fail. Spectral phenomena are treated as readable signs in a shared causal order, not random horror.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Violent or unjust death leaves unspent qi and unpaid claims. 2. Inference: That residue can appear as haunting, dream-indictment, or omen. 3. Inference: Proper investigation, burial, or restitution settles the manifestation. 4. Inference: Ignoring the sign multiplies disorder in the living household/locale. 5. Conclusion: Spirit events are ethical diagnostics of incomplete justice.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When charts show strong 印/官 with sudden yin-clash and ancestral illness themes, consider ‘unfinished family cases’ as part of counseling scope (without superstition theater). 2. Use ghost-logic as metaphor for trauma inheritance and legal loose ends. 3. Cultivation: complete rites for the dead; leave no deliberate injustice unpaid. 4. In fengshui/year-luck, treat recurring nightmare-omens as prompts to correct concrete wrongs first.
entries.logic_compare: More systematic and case-like than single romantic ghosting in 霍小玉传. Less philosophically skeptical than 论衡, which denies many spirit claims; 鬼董 assumes a populated moral cosmos. Differs from 西湖三塔记 by emphasizing justice-seeking dead over seductive demoness predation.

entries.logic_thesis: The miscellany form proves that moral and social truths are best captured as distributed anecdotes rather than single dogma: pattern emerges from many small causal episodes of reward, fraud, coincidence, and bureaucratic life. It argues implicitly that reality’s logic is granular—virtue and cunning leave traces in everyday bargains, marriages, and official posts. Knowledge is inductive: collect cases, then infer regularities of ren and li.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Human affairs are too varied for one narrative template. 2. Inference: Brief factual/moral sketches preserve causal kernels without epic distortion. 3. Inference: Recurring outcomes across tales reveal stable ethical mechanics (cheat → exposure; kindness → return). 4. Inference: The reader becomes a pattern-learner rather than a devotee of one hero. 5. Conclusion: Wisdom is statistical-moral: many small proofs converge on how ming and xing interact.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Train BaZi students with case libraries (like 杂说): many charts beat one theory. 2. When a single classical rule fails, add counter-cases before discarding the rule. 3. Cultivation: keep a personal ‘杂说’ journal of cause-effect in daily conduct. 4. Prefer modest, testable claims over grand fate proclamations.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 春秋繁露 or 白虎通义, it does not build a closed cosmological system; its authority is empirical-anecdotal. Unlike chuanqi masterpieces focused on one passion, it democratizes logic across ordinary lives. Closest in spirit to 论衡’s case-mindedness but without Wang Chong’s systematic polemic.

entries.logic_thesis: Wang Chong proves that many ‘heavenly’ and omen claims fail when tested against consistency, proportion, and natural mechanism: thunder, disasters, sages’ births, and ghostly anecdotes must obey the same qi physics as ordinary events. The core argument is epistemic hygiene—correlate claims with verifiable patterns; reject flattering teleology that makes heaven a moral micromanager of every human reward. Destiny exists as endowment and circumstance, but not as constant moral puppetry.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: True principles must apply uniformly, not only to sages and kings. 2. Inference: If heaven instantly punishes evil, the thriving of villains contradicts the theory. 3. Inference: Many portents are natural qi transformations misread as messages. 4. Inference: Exaggerated miracle-tales inflate human prestige, not cosmic fact. 5. Conclusion: Critical naturalism is a moral duty; superstition is bad reasoning, not piety.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi practice, separate structural chart logic from fear-based folk taboos; demand repeatable rules. 2. When clients bring omens, ask for base rates and alternative natural causes first. 3. Cultivation: empty the mind of flattering ‘heaven favors me’ stories; keep yi aligned with evidence. 4. Use 论衡 as quality-control: every fate claim needs mechanism + counterexample check. 5. Teach that skepticism protects Dao rather than insulting it.
entries.logic_compare: Directly opposes 春秋繁露’s dense heaven-human reward machinery and 白虎通义’s sacralized institutions. Differs from ghost fiction (鬼董, 白娘子) by demoting spirits as default explainers. Its kinship is with scientific Dao: order without arbitrary miracle.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that political order is legitimate only when it mirrors a standardized cosmic taxonomy: ranks, kinship, rituals, and punishments are justified as enactments of yin-yang and five-phase structure, not mere custom. By freezing debate into orthodox definitions, it argues that social language must be calibrated to heaven’s categories or the state loses sacral coherence. Logic here is classificatory: correct names → correct roles → stable realm.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Heaven’s patterns (yin-yang, wuxing, directions) are normative, not decorative. 2. Inference: Human offices and family grades should encode those patterns. 3. Inference: Ritual and law are technologies for keeping names aligned with cosmic roles. 4. Inference: Heterodox naming breeds political chaos. 5. Conclusion: Orthodoxy is a logical instrument of cosmic-political resonance.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Map BaZi ten-gods ethics to role clarity: Officer as duty-name, Resource as legitimation, Wealth as proper exchange—misnamed roles create chart ‘chaos.’ 2. In counseling institutions, restore clear titles/responsibilities before luck-cycle talk. 3. Cultivation: practice zhengming in speech—say what relations truly are. 4. Use wuxing seasonality as calendar for work/rest, not only divination ornament.
entries.logic_compare: More institutional and handbook-like than 春秋繁露’s prophetic, resonant cosmology. Less critical than 论衡; it constructs sacred bureaucracy rather than testing it. Differs from 新语 by heavier scholastic systematization after imperial Confucianism has already won.

entries.logic_thesis: Dong Zhongshu proves a correlative causal thesis: heaven and humanity form one resonant body, so royal virtue and vice stimulate corresponding climatic, astronomical, and social effects. History (Spring and Autumn) is read as coded case law of that resonance, elevating the ruler’s self-cultivation into the master variable of collective fate. The argument welds ethics, cosmology, and politics into a single feedback system.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Qi connects celestial signs, seasons, and human conduct. 2. Inference: The ruler’s xin is the most amplified node in that network. 3. Inference: Portents are warnings within a moral-cybernetic loop, not pure accidents. 4. Inference: Reform of policy and person can retune heaven’s response. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation of the sovereign (and by extension the self) is cosmological engineering.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Read annual luck as resonance feedback: clashes/punishments as ‘warnings’ to adjust conduct, not only as hits to endure. 2. For leadership charts, prioritize Day Master balance + Officer harmony as state-of-body politics. 3. Cultivation: daily examine intention; small xin-deviations scale up in high-responsibility positions. 4. Use five-phase correspondences therapeutically (seasonal living) while avoiding fatalistic omen panic—pair with 论衡’s checks.
entries.logic_compare: Maximal heaven-human micromanagement versus 论衡’s critique. More dynamic and omen-centered than 白虎通义’s static definitions. Unlike novelistic karma (霍小玉), resonance is institutional and climatic, not primarily romantic-ghostly.

entries.logic_thesis: Lu Jia proves that newly won empire cannot be held by force alone: the same martial logic that conquers becomes the seed of collapse unless replaced by ren-yi governance and measured institutions. The argument is transitional causality—tools must change when phases change; success-pattern of wartime is peacetime poison. Virtue is not soft ornament but the hard technology of duration.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Qin’s fall shows that severe law and conquest-qi exhaust the people. 2. Inference: Han must switch from taking the world to keeping the world. 3. Inference: Moral persuasion, frugality, and ritual order lower systemic friction. 4. Inference: Legitimacy compounds when rulers model restraint. 5. Conclusion: Phase-appropriate method is the logic of lasting ming for a regime.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi decade luck, when output/war stars give way to resource/official phases, retrain strategy: stop ‘conquest habits’ in career/relationships. 2. After any victory (exam, wealth windfall), install ren-yi routines immediately. 3. Cultivation: ask ‘what phase am I in?’ before applying old tactics. 4. Counsel founders: building and sustaining need different five-element emphases.
entries.logic_compare: Earlier and leaner than 春秋繁露’s full correlative theology; more practical-political than 白虎通义’s encyclopedic orthodoxy. Differs from literary cautionary tales by addressing statecraft directly rather than through romance allegory.

entries.logic_thesis: Lu Yu proves that a humble material practice—tea—can encode the entire path of discrimination, timing, and harmony: tool, water, fire, leaf, and drinker must co-resonate or the Dao of tea fails. The argument elevates craft to cultivation: excellence is the alignment of process variables, not mystical gift. Aesthetic discipline trains the same faculties needed for governing self and sensing qi.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Tea quality emerges only when multiple conditions are correctly staged. 2. Inference: Each error (bad water, wrong fire, coarse implement) is diagnosable and correctable. 3. Inference: The practitioner’s attention is itself an ingredient. 4. Inference: Repeated refined practice stabilizes taste, body, and mind together. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation is exacting process design applied to daily matter.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Treat BaZi reading as tea craft: sequence (year-month-day-hour), proportion, and context—no single star sipped alone. 2. Daily tea (or analogous ritual) as mindfulness of fire-water balance in the body chart. 3. Cultivation: refine one ordinary act to mastery; transfer that discrimination to emotion and speech. 4. In weak Earth/Resource charts, use slow, warm, ritualized routines to tonify. 5. Teach clients: fate work is quality control, not spells.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike cosmological summae (春秋繁露), it proves metaphysics through craft empiricism. Unlike moral biographies, it barely moralizes yet yields ethical calm via form. Closest to Daoist techne: the way is in the doing’s precision.

entries.logic_thesis: The story proves that crafted beauty and human passion create durable soul-bonds that outlast murder and institutional violence: the jade Guanyin is both commodity and spiritual double of the beloved. Art objectifies affection into a portable fate-token; attempts to possess persons as property generate lethal pushback from the life-force so compressed. Love’s logic here is artisanal and spectral—form retains intent.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Mastery embeds the maker’s and lover’s qi into the work. 2. Inference: The artwork becomes a hinge between social world and spirit world. 3. Inference: Forcing lovers apart for elite convenience ruptures that hinge violently. 4. Inference: Posthumous reunion via the jade image restores moral symmetry. 5. Conclusion: Objectified beauty can carry unfinished destiny across death.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When charts show strong Output (食伤) + Wealth, warn that creations and lovers intertwine—destroying one harms the other. 2. Counsel artisans: works hold intention; create cleanly. 3. Cultivation: treat treasured objects as mirrors of attachment; release possession-greed. 4. In grief work, a crafted memorial can stabilize qi better than abstract denial.
entries.logic_compare: More object-mediated than 霍小玉’s pure ghost vengeance. Less bureaucratic than 无双传’s living stratagems. Differs from 白娘子 by centering human craft-sanctity rather than species-crossing demon-love, though both seal passion into monuments.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that judicial certainty built on coincidence is a machine for manufacturing innocent ghosts: when officials prefer narrative neatness over causal proof, the legal system becomes a karma factory. Random adjacency (timing, words, objects) is misread as guilt, demonstrating a logic of epistemic sin—laziness of investigation as moral crime. Tragedy is not fate’s cruelty alone but method’s failure.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: True judgment requires distinguishing correlation from causation. 2. Inference: Circumstantial clusters can mimic guilt under stress and greed for closure. 3. Inference: Torture and haste convert hypothesis into ‘confession.’ 4. Inference: Wrongful death generates social and spectral debt. 5. Conclusion: Righteous process is a cosmic duty; bad epistemology kills.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi/event analysis, forbid single-sign verdicts—require multi-factor triangulation (like good detective work). 2. When Officer stars are harsh without Resource clarity, flag wrongful accusation years; advise documentation and calm procedure. 3. Cultivation: slow down judgment of others; practice ‘doubt as compassion.’ 4. Organizational counsel: incentive structures that reward quick closure invite 错斩 patterns.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike romance-driven Tang tales, the villain is procedure itself. Aligns with 论衡’s demand for testing, but dramatized as courtroom horror. Differs from 鬼董 by showing how living courts, not only past murders, birth new wrongs.

entries.logic_thesis: The tale proves that unchecked erotic-yin allure without anchoring yi becomes predatory depletion: beautiful beings at West Lake seduce, imprison, and consume men, encoding a warning about desire-fields that look like pleasure and act like traps. The three towers as seal demonstrate that chaotic seduction must be fixed by ritual structure—form binds excessive yin. Survival depends on recognizing pattern early and invoking ordered power.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Scenic beauty and sexual hospitality can mask extractive intent. 2. Inference: Repeated vanishing of men indicates a stable predatory mechanism, not accident. 3. Inference: Ordinary charm cannot reform entities whose nature is to drain. 4. Inference: Sacred sealing (towers/ritual) restores landscape balance. 5. Conclusion: Some attractions are not relationships but ecosystems of consumption; only boundary-form ends them.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Peach Blossom + heavy yin water without Officer/Resource: counsel strict boundaries in nightlife, speculative romance, ‘magical’ partners. 2. Teach recognition of energy drain after encounters—body is evidence. 3. Cultivation: tower-logic = vows, schedules, community seals against addiction loops. 4. Fengshui metaphor: seal ‘leaking’ sectors of life where qi exits via lust or fantasy.
entries.logic_compare: Harsher than 白娘子, which allows genuine love before sealing; here the feminine spectral is primarily lethal. Unlike 莺莺传’s male blame-shift, the danger is dramatized as external demon to train vigilance—though modern reading must not misogynize the symbol. Differs from 灌园叟 by showing hostile rather than benevolent nature-spirits.

entries.logic_thesis: The story proves that disinterested care for living beauty (flowers) aligns a humble human with immortal justice: devotion without possession-greed summons protective numen, while destructive bullies draw retribution. Late-life reward demonstrates that sincerity accumulates interest; age does not bar communion with the Dao of nature. The garden is a moral cosmos in miniature.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Plants are living partners in qi, not mere decoration. 2. Inference: Daily non-violent tending builds reciprocity with nature’s spirits. 3. Inference: Wanton destruction of beauty is violence against that order. 4. Inference: Immortal response vindicates the gardener and punishes the wreckers. 5. Conclusion: Cultivation of care is efficacious prayer; heaven backs measured biophilia.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For lonely late-luck charts, prescribe tangible care practice (plants, craft) as Resource-star generation. 2. When Wealth is strong but kindness weak, warn of ‘flower-trampling’ karma in business. 3. Cultivation: serve without owning; admire without plucking—the Daoist non-grasping aesthetic. 4. Seasonal gardening as wuxing embodiment training.
entries.logic_compare: Inverse of 西湖三塔记’s hostile nature-femme: here the fairy is just and salvific. Softer commercial fate than 转运汉; the capital is virtue-care, not trade cunning. Differs from imperial resonance texts by locating heaven’s feedback in a backyard garden, not the throne.

entries.logic_thesis: The tale proves that fortune’s turn often rides on undervalued goods, timing, and cross-market arbitrage: what is trivial at home can be precious abroad, so ‘destiny’ appears when perception and logistics meet opportunity. The logic is proto-economic Dao—value is relational, not intrinsic; luck is preparedness colliding with asymmetric demand. Moral of circulation: stagnation is poverty of imagination, not only of capital.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Local surplus can be foreign scarcity. 2. Inference: Agents who move goods across contexts capture hidden value. 3. Inference: Prior ‘failure’ at home may be misallocation of talents/goods, not absolute uselessness. 4. Inference: One well-timed cargo rewrites social status. 5. Conclusion: Ming includes commercial topology; reading markets is reading qi-flows of desire.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Charts with Traveling Horse + Wealth: emphasize mobility, export of skills, not local grinding. 2. Counsel ‘Dongting orange’ audits: what do I undervalue that another field needs? 3. Cultivation: stay light enough to move when luck pivots; hoarding fixed identity blocks 转运. 4. In annual luck, act in the first window of a wealth combination—hesitation misses cargo tides.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure moral reward tales (灌园叟), pivot is mercantile cleverness plus chance. Unlike 错斩崔宁, coincidence is beneficent when paired with enterprise. Differs from 镜花缘’s satirical voyages by celebrating profit logistics over utopian anthropology.

entries.logic_thesis: The legend proves a tragic collision between species-law (or cosmic ordinance) and sincere cross-boundary love: White Snake’s devotion is real, yet her nature violates the order Fahai polices, so compassion and doctrine cannot fully reconcile. Sealing under Leifeng Pagoda argues that society/religion will immobilize desires that threaten categorical boundaries, even at the cost of human happiness. The child and lingering sympathy show partial integration—love leaves lineage even when the lover is suppressed.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Beings of different ontological orders can form genuine qing. 2. Inference: That qing still triggers guardians of categorical law. 3. Inference: Human spouse is torn between lived gratitude and doctrinal fear. 4. Inference: Institutional sacred power can contain but not annihilate the story’s moral claim. 5. Conclusion: Order and love are co-truths; tragedy is their non-identity in a given age.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Relationship counseling: identify ‘species clashes’—class, family cult, lifestyle cosmologies—that act as Fahai. 2. BaZi: strong yin-Water Peach Blossom vs strong Standing Officer/seven-kill religious authority patterns. 3. Cultivation: know which boundaries protect growth and which only police difference. 4. Ritual ‘tower’ as voluntary containment of addictive love until integration matures—not only external oppression. 5. Honor offspring/projects born of difficult unions as legitimate qi continuation.
entries.logic_compare: More ethically ambivalent than 西湖三塔记’s clear demon-threat. Unlike 霍小玉, the nonhuman woman is lover-benefactor, not only avenger. Differs from 长恨歌传 by making the boundary cosmic-species rather than solely political excess—though both end in sealed longing.

entries.logic_thesis: Li Ruzhen proves by inverted countries and exams for women that ‘nature’ of gender and custom is often local convention mirrored as necessity: travel defamiliarizes the homeland’s logic and exposes its contingency. Talent (cai) exists widely; institutions that refuse to measure it waste cosmic endowment. The mirror-flower image argues that ideal orders are visible yet hard to grasp—critique without naive utopia of easy arrival.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Social rules feel natural only from inside. 2. Inference: Encountering inverted norms reveals the constructedness of one’s own. 3. Inference: Women’s exclusion from literary-official glory is custom-failure, not heaven’s decree. 4. Inference: Satire educates freer measurement of human worth. 5. Conclusion: True cosmic logic values cultivated talent over inherited role-fictions.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi, read Output/Resource in any sex’s chart as real capacity—refuse cultural discounting. 2. Use ‘foreign kingdom’ thought-experiments with clients stuck in family scripts. 3. Cultivation: travel, languages, and alien crafts as mirrors that polish self-knowledge. 4. Exam/talent systems: design fair measures; biased gates create false ming.
entries.logic_compare: Broader sociological mirror than single-hero chuanqi. Less despairing than 老残游记’s diagnostic realism; still playful-utopian. Differs from 白虎通义 by prying open orthodox role taxonomy rather than sacralizing it.

entries.logic_thesis: The novel proves that a civilization in late decay needs diagnostic perception more than heroic posturing: Lao Can’s itinerant doctor-gaze models how to read symptoms in rivers, courts, and ‘honest’ officials whose rigidity kills. Good intentions without systemic understanding become new instruments of harm; clear seeing is the prerequisite of any cure. Fate of the age is a medical case: misdiagnosis multiplies death.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Social illness presents as flood, injustice, and performative virtue. 2. Inference: Surface moralism can mask procedural cruelty. 3. Inference: The observer who lacks office may see clearer than those trapped in role. 4. Inference: Partial technical fixes (engineering, legal shrewdness) help only if diagnosis is true. 5. Conclusion: Cultivated attention—clinical, mobile, unfooled—is the core political-spiritual skill in an ending phase.
entries.logic_practice: 1. BaZi for eras/orgs: when Officer is fake-strong and Resource corrupted, prioritize truth-telling over loyalty theater. 2. Personal cultivation: develop ‘Lao Can eyes’—tour symptoms, test interventions, avoid savior complex. 3. In clash periods of national or company life, be itinerant learner, not rigid partisan. 4. Medicine metaphor for luck cycles: tonify what is deficient, drain what is excess—never punish the symptom alone. 5. Document cases like a travelogue; pattern recognition beats slogan.
entries.logic_compare: Darker and more realist than 镜花缘’s allegory-tour. Unlike Han cosmological manuals that assume reform from the throne’s virtue alone, it trusts peripheral diagnostic intelligence. Differs from justice tales like 错斩崔宁 by embedding single wrongs in a whole failing organism—the late-Qing body politic.
